title: client_objectiveai_mcp.client_response.Response
description:
Envelope: correlation `id` + tagged [`super::Result`]. Wire shape:

```json
{"id":"…","type":"ok"}                         // empty success
{"id":"…","type":"error","code":404,"message":…}  // failure
```

anyOf.description: Empty success — the request was accepted.

The request failed. With internally-tagged + struct-variant
serde flattens the inner fields alongside the `type` tag —
e.g. `{"id":"…","type":"error","code":404,"message":…}`.

id.description:
Matches the `id` of the
[`super::super::client_request::Request`] this response is for.
